vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: prospect
Version: 1.0.0

The 'prospect' skill bundle is a conceptual framework designed to help an AI agent assist users with business development and sales targeting. It contains structured instructions and logic (represented in Python-like syntax within skill.md) for defining prospect profiles, scoring criteria, and workflows, with no executable code, data exfiltration risks, or malicious prompt injection.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only prospecting methodology skill; its stated purpose matches its contents and it requests no installs, credentials, or system access.

dimensions.detail: The name and description (prospect identification/prioritization/outreach) align with the SKILL.md content, which is a structured methodology and templates for prospecting. Nothing in the skill requests unrelated resources or capabilities.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains guidance, scoring frameworks, workflows, and response rules only. It does not instruct the agent to read files, access environment variables, call external endpoints, or perform privileged system actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files are present; this is instruction-only so nothing is downloaded or written to disk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. There are no requested secrets or external service keys that would be disproportionate to a prospecting guide.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable with normal autonomous invocation allowed. It does not request permanent presence or modify other skills/configurations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a safe, self-contained prospecting playbook: it only gives templates and rules and asks for no secrets or installs. Before using, decide whether you want the agent to act on these outputs (e.g., push prospects into your CRM) — if you later connect automation to external systems, provide minimal, scoped credentials for that integration and review any new SKILL.md changes. Also avoid pasting sensitive company or personal data into prompts unless you're comfortable storing/processing it with the agent.
